assets.name: friend-btn
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the Friends button to update. Image 2 is the approved new matching button style. Redraw Friends to match image 2's airy pastel painted storybook art, ivory scalloped lace badge and pink dashed stitching. Preserve image 1's bunny and bear faces side by side with the add-friend plus symbol below; keep expressions cute and legible. Bunny ivory white, bear soft pastel honey peach, plus blush pink. Use a thin, distinct warm champagne GOLD outline along the outer scalloped edge, a little richer and more golden than image 2's pale peach edge, approximately #D5A653 with lighter #F1D397 accents. Keep it delicate, no thick rings or dark brown border. Keep all inner fills bright soft pastels and ivory. Same centered badge scale and proportions as image 2, square transparent PNG, 94 percent canvas occupancy. Transparent alpha outside entire scalloped badge, no shadows outside, no added text, no notification dot.
